data.name: Highlights of Boston Photo Tour
data.headline: 2 Hours | Beacon Hill | Public Garden | Back Bay
data.description:
Discover Boston’s must-see attractions on this popular photography and history walking tour. Explore the city's most scenic areas: Beacon Hill, Public Garden and Back Bay.

Learn how to capture creative pictures of Boston's famous attractions and iconic landmarks with your camera or smartphone.

Fascinating commentary and creative photo tips are provided throughout the walking tour.

All skill levels are welcome. Advance reservations required. Space is limited. Small group tour.
data.cancellation_notes:
#Cancellation Policy#

Full refund or credit with at least 24 hours notice by customer.

Full refund or credit if a tour is canceled by PhotoWalks due to weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances. 

No refunds for no-shows.
